description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Develop and deploy bespoke machine learning models for a software product, owning the work from raw data preparation through to live operation. Collaborate with colleagues across functions to turn product ideas into shipped features, within a small, fast-moving, fully on-site team.
 What you'll do
 - Create, fit and assess proprietary neural models and learned representations that power the product.
 - Take charge of the full data workflow, from sourcing and cleaning through to the model fitting framework.
 - Strengthen the tooling used to run experiments, track results and reproduce outcomes.
 - Move models from early prototype into live use, then watch their behavior and refine them based on real usage.
 - Work with product and other colleagues to convert needs into machine learning solutions and release new capabilities.
 - Write tidy, efficient Python and join in peer review, testing and troubleshooting.
 - Follow current research developments and introduce promising techniques to the team.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Around 4 or more years working as a machine learning engineer in industry, or comparable research experience.
 - A graduate degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, with solid grounding in machine learning.
 - A track record of designing neural networks from the ground up rather than only adapting pretrained ones.
 - Experience devising original modeling approaches instead of leaning on ready-made tools.
 - Working knowledge of PyTorch or a similar deep learning library.
 - Hands-on experience with large language models and transformer architectures.
 - Exposure to graph-based neural architectures.
 - Experience delivering machine learning in production settings, with a clear sense of production standards; this is not a purely academic role.
 - Advanced Python skills and the ability to produce dependable code on your own.
 - Comfort juggling several priorities in a fast-paced startup.
 - Sharp problem-solving, careful attention to detail, and strong communication and collaboration.
 Bonus points
 - Familiarity with world models.
 - Prior work in scientific or physical-world areas such as robotics or simulation.
 - Experience with managed machine learning services or large cloud providers.
 - Backend development experience with a Python web framework and SQL.
 - Background in CAD or geometry-focused computing.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 175,000 to 250,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Flexible time off
 - Professional development opportunities
 Location and work model
 - San Mateo, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
